verdicts.expected: LAYER-FOUND; H1 known truth already staged
verdicts.mechanism: The layer is Texas State Plane Central, WKID 102739/latestWkid 2277. discover.ts extentToBbox treats any coordinate magnitude >180 as Web Mercator, converts State Plane feet with the Mercator formula, and then rejects the true zoning layer as outside the city bbox.
verdicts.sourceEvidence: Live FeatureServer/0 sample returns Zone_Code=R-1 and CITY_LIMIT=ELGIN; store truth still has elgin-tx 3209 rows / 8 district codes from H1.

verdicts.mechanism: Same projection defect: MapServer/20 is zoning, geometry polygon, ZONE/FULLZONE fields, WKID 102739/latestWkid 2277. The factory misreads State Plane feet as Web Mercator before bbox overlap.
verdicts.sourceEvidence: Live MapServer/20 renderer and sample carry AG/BP/C-1/C-3/CN/IN/MF-1/MF-2/MH/MU-DT/OF/PF/RE/RL/RS/TF/TH. Store truth still has georgetown-tx 1890 rows / 17 district codes from Z1.

verdicts.expected: Honest factory verdict after Z1 searched-and-absent; only zoning polygon may be LAYER-FOUND
verdicts.mechanism: Geometry+field-shape gate accepted a Denton Parks layer because park names happened to satisfy district-code token heuristics and the county-scale extent overlaps Frisco. The selected OID field is OBJECTID_1, but normalize.ts only accepts attributes.OBJECTID/objectid/FID, producing a second seam failure.
verdicts.storeSafety: No frisco-tx staging rows were written.

verdicts.note: Hub returned a Floodplain FeatureServer; no positive zoning layer or absence determination.

verdicts.sourceEvidence: constraintLayers=2 after full recurse; no Euclidean candidate

storeVerification.interpretation: Pilot introduced no staging rows. Existing Elgin/Georgetown rows were preserved.

stopReason: The dispatch says OPERATE the built factory, not build one. Continuing a 440-city --stage-apply fan after a 5-city pilot produced one non-zoning LAYER-FOUND and missed both known zoning controls would knowingly stage false data and overwrite roster truth. That conflicts with AGENT_CONTRACT verification/fail-closed rules and the dispatch's geometry+field identification requirement. No production fan was started.
requiredFactoryRepairsBeforeRetry: Projection handling must distinguish supported CRS and request/query outSR=4326 or transform known WKIDs; never infer Web Mercator solely from coordinate magnitude.
Layer identity must require zoning semantics beyond generic code-like values and bbox overlap; a Parks NAME/Class layer must fail.
Staging must use the service-declared OID field (objectIdFieldName or esriFieldTypeOID), not only OBJECTID/objectid/FID.
Fail the run, not only emit stage-error, when a LAYER-FOUND city cannot stage; do not mark that city landed.
constraintsHonored: No PostGIS query or heavy-scan announcement
tx_zoning_district_staging only, with zero pilot writes
no roster mutations from invalid verdicts
no code changes to repair the factory
